# dtcloud_images (Data Source)

Lists every image visible to the caller.

Every filter is applied by the provider rather than passed to the API. The endpoint does take a visibility parameter, but it only separates public images from the rest: asking it for `private` returns the private, shared and community ones together. Filtering here means `visibility = "private"` returns private images, which is what it says.

The list endpoint reports two fields the details endpoint does not, so `dtcloud_image` can report an empty `os_type` for an image that appears here with one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dtcloud_images" "private_active" {
  visibility = "private"
  status     = "active"
}

data "dtcloud_images" "ubuntu" {
  os_distro = "ubuntu"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Only return images with this exact name. Applied by the provider.
- `os_distro` (String) Only return images carrying this distribution. Applied by the provider.
- `status` (String) Only return images in this status, e.g. `active`. Applied by the provider.
- `visibility` (String) Only return images with this visibility. Applied by the provider, because the endpoint's own filter only separates public images from the rest.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `images` (List of Object) The images that matched, in the order the platform returned them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--images))
